translations.idiomatic: Now they borrow the Son of Heaven's authority to imprison the various ministers, and again borrow the name of offending the ruler to adorn their own faults.

sentences.zh: 負國負君，罪莫大此。

translations.literal: Betraying the state and betraying the ruler — no crime is greater than this.
translations.idiomatic: Betraying the state and betraying the ruler — no crime is greater than this.

sentences.zh: 」意為憲成諸人發。

translations.literal: This was intended on behalf of Xiancheng and his circle.
translations.idiomatic: This was intended on behalf of Xiancheng and his circle.

sentences.zh: 已，復極陳朝政廢壞，請帝奮然有為，與天下更始。

translations.literal: Thereafter he again argued at length that court government was ruined and begged the emperor to rouse himself to action and make a fresh start with all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter he again argued at length that court government was ruined and begged the emperor to rouse himself to action and make a fresh start with all under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 且力言遼左阽危，必難永保狀。

translations.literal: And he argued forcefully that the eastern frontier was in extreme peril and could not long be preserved.
translations.idiomatic: And he argued forcefully that the eastern frontier was in extreme peril and could not long be preserved.

sentences.zh: 帝皆置不省。

translations.literal: The emperor set all aside without notice.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor set all aside without notice.

sentences.zh: 三才揮霍有大略，在淮久，以折稅監得民心。

translations.literal: Sancai was liberal and possessed great strategic vision; he had long been on the Huai and won the people's hearts by curbing tax commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Sancai was liberal and possessed great strategic vision; he had long been on the Huai and won the people's hearts by curbing tax commissioners.

sentences.zh: 及淮、徐歲侵，又請振恤，蠲馬價。

translations.literal: When the Huai and Xu regions suffered annual disasters, he again asked for relief and exemption from horse prices.
translations.idiomatic: When the Huai and Xu regions suffered annual disasters, he again asked for relief and exemption from horse prices.

sentences.zh: 淮人深德之。

translations.literal: The people of the Huai deeply thanked him.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the Huai deeply thanked him.

sentences.zh: 屢加至戶部尚書。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted until Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted until Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 會內閣缺人，建議者謂不當專用詞臣，宜與外僚參用，意在三才。

translations.literal: It happened that the Grand Secretariat lacked men; those who offered advice said literary officials alone should not be used exclusively — outside officials should participate, with Sancai in mind.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that the Grand Secretariat lacked men; those who offered advice said literary officials alone should not be used exclusively — outside officials should participate, with Sancai in mind.

sentences.zh: 及都御史缺，需次內召。

translations.literal: When the post of Censor-in-Chief fell vacant, he was next in seniority for internal summons.
translations.idiomatic: When the post of Censor-in-Chief fell vacant, he was next in seniority for internal summons.

sentences.zh: 由是忌者日眾，謗議紛然。

translations.literal: From this those who envied him grew daily more numerous and slander and debate swirled.
translations.idiomatic: From this those who envied him grew daily more numerous and slander and debate swirled.

sentences.zh: 工部郎中邵輔忠遂劾三才大奸似忠，大詐似直，列具貪偽險橫四大罪，御史徐兆魁繼之。

translations.literal: Director in the Ministry of Works Shao Fuzhong then impeached Sancai as great wickedness resembling loyalty, great deceit resembling uprightness, listing in detail four great crimes of greed, falsehood, treachery, and violence; censor Xu Zhaokui followed him.
translations.idiomatic: Director in the Ministry of Works Shao Fuzhong then impeached Sancai as great wickedness resembling loyalty, great deceit resembling uprightness, listing in detail four great crimes of greed, falsehood, treachery, and violence; censor Xu Zhaokui followed him.

sentences.zh: 三才四疏力辨，且乞休。

translations.literal: Sancai submitted four memorials arguing forcefully and also begged to retire.
translations.idiomatic: Sancai submitted four memorials arguing forcefully and also begged to retire.

sentences.zh: 給事中馬從龍、御史董兆舒、彭端吾、南京給事中金士衡相繼為三才辨。

translations.literal: Supervising secretaries Ma Conglong, censors Dong Zhaoshu, Peng Duanwu, and Nanjing supervising secretary Jin Shiheng in succession argued for Sancai.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising secretaries Ma Conglong, censors Dong Zhaoshu, Peng Duanwu, and Nanjing supervising secretary Jin Shiheng in succession argued for Sancai.

sentences.zh: 大學士葉向高言三才已杜門待罪，宜速定去留，為漕政計。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Ye Xianggao said Sancai had already shut his doors awaiting punishment and ought quickly to be decided whether to stay or go, for the sake of transport policy.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Ye Xianggao said Sancai had already shut his doors awaiting punishment and ought quickly to be decided whether to stay or go, for the sake of transport policy.

sentences.zh: 皆不報。

translations.literal: None received response.
translations.idiomatic: None received response.

sentences.zh: 已而南京兵部郎中錢策，南京給事中劉時俊，御史劉國縉、喬應甲，給事中王紹徵、徐紹吉、周永春、姚宗文、朱一桂、李瑾，南京御史張邦俊、王萬祚，復連章劾三才。

translations.literal: Before long Nanjing Bureau of Military Affairs Director Qian Ce, Nanjing supervising secretaries Liu Shijun, censors Liu Guoji, Qiao Yingjia, supervising secretaries Wang Shaozheng, Xu Shaoji, Zhou Yongchun, Yao Zongwen, Zhu Yigui, and Li Jin, and Nanjing censors Zhang Bangjun and Wang Wanzuo again submitted linked memorials impeaching Sancai.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Nanjing Bureau of Military Affairs Director Qian Ce, Nanjing supervising secretaries Liu Shijun, censors Liu Guoji, Qiao Yingjia, supervising secretaries Wang Shaozheng, Xu Shaoji, Zhou Yongchun, Yao Zongwen, Zhu Yigui, and Li Jin, and Nanjing censors Zhang Bangjun and Wang Wanzuo again submitted linked memorials impeaching Sancai.

sentences.zh: 而給事中胡忻、曹於汴，南京給事中段然，御史史學遷、史記事、馬孟禎、王基洪，又交章論救。

translations.literal: Yet supervising secretaries Hu Xin and Cao Yubian, Nanjing supervising secretary Duan Ran, and censors Shi Xueqian, Shi Jishi, Ma Mengzhen, and Wang Jihong in turn submitted linked memorials arguing in his defense.
translations.idiomatic: Yet supervising secretaries Hu Xin and Cao Yubian, Nanjing supervising secretary Duan Ran, and censors Shi Xueqian, Shi Jishi, Ma Mengzhen, and Wang Jihong in turn submitted linked memorials arguing in his defense.

sentences.zh: 朝端聚訟，迄數月未已。

translations.literal: At court the factions gathered in dispute, continuing for several months without end.
translations.idiomatic: At court the factions gathered in dispute, continuing for several months without end.

sentences.zh: 憲成乃貽書向高，力稱三才廉直，又貽書孫丕揚力辨之。

translations.literal: Xiancheng then sent a letter to Xianggao strongly praising Sancai's integrity and uprightness, and also sent a letter to Sun Piyang arguing forcefully in his defense.
translations.idiomatic: Xiancheng then sent a letter to Xianggao strongly praising Sancai's integrity and uprightness, and also sent a letter to Sun Piyang arguing forcefully in his defense.

sentences.zh: 御史吳亮素善三才，即以兩書附傳邸報中，由是議者益嘩。

translations.literal: Censor Wu Liang, who had always been friendly with Sancai, attached both letters to the courier gazette; from this the debaters grew still more clamorous.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Wu Liang, who had always been friendly with Sancai, attached both letters to the courier gazette; from this the debaters grew still more clamorous.

sentences.zh: 應甲復兩疏力訐，至列其十貪五奸。

translations.literal: Yingjia again submitted two memorials arguing forcefully, going so far as to list ten instances of greed and five of treachery.
translations.idiomatic: Yingjia again submitted two memorials arguing forcefully, going so far as to list ten instances of greed and five of treachery.

sentences.zh: 帝皆不省。

translations.literal: The emperor took notice of none of it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor took notice of none of it.

sentences.zh: 三才亦力請罷，疏至十五上。

translations.literal: Sancai also argued forcefully to be dismissed; his memorials reached fifteen submissions.
translations.idiomatic: Sancai also argued forcefully to be dismissed; his memorials reached fifteen submissions.

sentences.zh: 久不得命，遂自引去。

translations.literal: For a long time he received no order and thereupon withdrew on his own.
translations.idiomatic: For a long time he received no order and thereupon withdrew on his own.

sentences.zh: 帝亦不罪也。

translations.literal: The emperor also did not punish him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also did not punish him.

sentences.zh: 三才既家居，忌者慮其復用。

translations.literal: After Sancai had returned home, those who envied him feared he would be used again.
translations.idiomatic: After Sancai had returned home, those who envied him feared he would be used again.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，御史劉光復劾其盜皇木營建私第至二十二萬有奇。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year censor Liu Guangfu impeached him for stealing imperial timber to build a private residence amounting to more than two hundred and twenty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year (1614) censor Liu Guangfu impeached him for stealing imperial timber to build a private residence amounting to more than two hundred and twenty thousand.

sentences.zh: 且言三才與於玉立遙執相權，意所欲用，銓部輒為推舉。

translations.literal: And he said Sancai, together with Yu Yuli, remotely wielded the power of chief minister; whomever they wished to use, the Ministry of Personnel would push forward.
translations.idiomatic: And he said Sancai, together with Yu Yuli, remotely wielded the power of chief minister; whomever they wished to use, the Ministry of Personnel would push forward.

sentences.zh: 三才疏辨，請遣中官按問。

translations.literal: Sancai memorialized in his defense and asked that palace eunuchs be sent to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Sancai memorialized in his defense and asked that palace eunuchs be sent to investigate.

sentences.zh: 給事中劉文炳、御史李徵儀、工部郎中聶心湯、大理丞王士昌，助光復力攻三才。

translations.literal: Supervising secretary Liu Wenbing, censor Li Zhengyi, Director in the Ministry of Works Nie Xintang, and Assistant Minister of the Court of Judicial Review Wang Shichang helped Guangfu attack Sancai with force.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising secretary Liu Wenbing, censor Li Zhengyi, Director in the Ministry of Works Nie Xintang, and Assistant Minister of the Court of Judicial Review Wang Shichang helped Guangfu attack Sancai with force.

sentences.zh: 徵儀、心湯，三才嘗舉吏也。

translations.literal: Zhengyi and Xintang were men Sancai had once recommended for office.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengyi and Xintang were men Sancai had once recommended for office.

sentences.zh: 三才憤甚，自請籍其家。

translations.literal: Sancai was extremely angry and asked on his own that his household be registered.
translations.idiomatic: Sancai was extremely angry and asked on his own that his household be registered.

sentences.zh: 工部侍郎林如楚言宜遣使覆勘。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Works Lin Ruchu said envoys ought to be sent for re-investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Works Lin Ruchu said envoys ought to be sent for re-investigation.

sentences.zh: 光復再疏，並言其侵奪官廠為園囿。

translations.literal: Guangfu memorialized again, also saying he had encroached on official workshops to make a garden.
translations.idiomatic: Guangfu memorialized again, also saying he had encroached on official workshops to make a garden.

sentences.zh: 御史劉廷元遂率同列繼之，而潘汝禎又特疏論劾。

translations.literal: Censor Liu Tingyuan then led his colleagues in succession, and Pan Ruzhen also specially memorialized in impeachment.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Liu Tingyuan then led his colleagues in succession, and Pan Ruzhen also specially memorialized in impeachment.

sentences.zh: 既而巡按御史顏思忠亦上疏如光復指。

translations.literal: Before long Surveillance Commissioner Yan Sizhong also memorialized as Guangfu had indicated.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Surveillance Commissioner Yan Sizhong also memorialized as Guangfu had indicated.

sentences.zh: 三才益憤，請諸臣會勘，又請帝親鞫。

translations.literal: Sancai grew still angrier and asked that the various ministers jointly investigate, and also asked that the emperor personally interrogate.
translations.idiomatic: Sancai grew still angrier and asked that the various ministers jointly investigate, and also asked that the emperor personally interrogate.

sentences.zh: 乃詔徵儀偕給事中吳亮嗣往。

translations.literal: An edict then ordered Zhengyi together with supervising secretary Wu Liang to go in succession.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then ordered Zhengyi together with supervising secretary Wu Liang to go in succession.

sentences.zh: 其明年，光復坐事下獄。

translations.literal: The next year Guangfu was imprisoned on account of an affair.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Guangfu was imprisoned on account of an affair.

sentences.zh: 三才陽請釋之，而復力為東林辨白，曰：「自沈一貫假撰妖書，擅僇楚宗，舉朝正人攻之以去。

translations.literal: Sancai openly asked that he be released, and again argued forcefully in defense of the Donglin faction, saying: "Since Shen Yiguan forged the demonic book and on his own authority punished the Prince of Chu, upright men of the whole court attacked him until he left.
translations.idiomatic: Sancai openly asked that he be released, and again argued forcefully in defense of the Donglin faction, saying, "Since Shen Yiguan forged the demonic book and on his own authority punished the Prince of Chu, upright men of the whole court attacked him until he left.

sentences.zh: 繼湯賓尹、韓敬科場作奸，孽由自取，於人何尤。

translations.literal: Then Tang Binyin and Han Jing committed fraud in the examination field — the calamity was of their own making; whom should others blame?
translations.idiomatic: Then Tang Binyin and Han Jing committed fraud in the examination field — the calamity was of their own making; whom should others blame?

sentences.zh: 而今之黨人動與正人為仇，士昌、光復尤為戎首。

translations.literal: Yet today's factionalists constantly make enemies of upright men; Shichang and Guangfu are especially the ringleaders.
translations.idiomatic: Yet today's factionalists constantly make enemies of upright men; Shichang and Guangfu are especially the ringleaders.

sentences.zh: 挺身主盟，力為一貫、敬報怨。

translations.literal: They thrust themselves forward as alliance leaders and strive to avenge Yiguan and Jing.
translations.idiomatic: They thrust themselves forward as alliance leaders and strive to avenge Yiguan and Jing.

sentences.zh: 騰說百端，攻擊千狀。

translations.literal: They spread a hundred kinds of rumor and launch a thousand forms of attack.
translations.idiomatic: They spread a hundred kinds of rumor and launch a thousand forms of attack.

sentences.zh: 以大臣之賢者言之，則葉向高去矣，王象乾、孫瑋、王圖、許弘綱去矣，曹於汴、胡忻、朱吾弼、葉茂才、南企仲、朱國禎等去矣，近又攻陳薦、汪應蛟去矣。

translations.literal: Speaking of worthy great ministers: Ye Xianggao has gone; Wang Xiangqian, Sun Wei, Wang Tu, and Xu Honggang have gone; Cao Yubian, Hu Xin, Zhu Wubi, Ye Maocai, Nan Qizhong, Zhu Guozhen, and others have gone; recently Chen Jian and Wang Yingjiao were also attacked until they left.
translations.idiomatic: Speaking of worthy great ministers: Ye Xianggao has gone; Wang Xiangqian, Sun Wei, Wang Tu, and Xu Honggang have gone; Cao Yubian, Hu Xin, Zhu Wubi, Ye Maocai, Nan Qizhong, Zhu Guozhen, and others have gone; recently Chen Jian and Wang Yingjiao were also attacked until they left.

sentences.zh: 以小臣之賢者言之，梅之煥、孫振基、段然、吳亮、馬孟禎、湯兆京、周起元、史學遷、錢春等去矣，李樸、鮑應鰲、丁元薦、龐時雍、吳正誌、劉宗周等去矣。

translations.literal: Speaking of worthy junior officials: Mei Zhihuan, Sun Zhenji, Duan Ran, Wu Liang, Ma Mengzhen, Tang Zhaojing, Zhou Qiyuan, Shi Xueqian, Qian Chun, and others have gone; Li Pu, Bao Ying'ao, Ding Yuansian, Pang Shiyong, Wu Zhengzhi, Liu Zongzhou, and others have gone.
translations.idiomatic: Speaking of worthy junior officials: Mei Zhihuan, Sun Zhenji, Duan Ran, Wu Liang, Ma Mengzhen, Tang Zhaojing, Zhou Qiyuan, Shi Xueqian, Qian Chun, and others have gone; Li Pu, Bao Ying'ao, Ding Yuansian, Pang Shiyong, Wu Zhengzhi, Liu Zongzhou, and others have gone.

sentences.zh: 合於己則留，不合則逐。

translations.literal: Those who agree with them are kept; those who disagree are driven out.
translations.idiomatic: Those who agree with them are kept; those who disagree are driven out.

sentences.zh: 陛下第知諸臣之去，豈知諸黨人驅之乎？

translations.literal: Your Majesty only knows that the various ministers have left — do you know that the factionalists drove them out?
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty only knows that the various ministers have left — do you know that the factionalists drove them out?

sentences.zh: 今奸黨仇正之言，一曰東林，一曰淮撫。

translations.literal: Today the wicked faction's words against the upright boil down to two labels: Donglin, and Grand Coordinator of the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Today the wicked faction's words against the upright boil down to two labels: Donglin, and Grand Coordinator of the Huai.

sentences.zh: 所謂東林者，顧憲成讀書講學之所也。

translations.literal: What is called Donglin is the place where Gu Xiancheng read books and lectured.
translations.idiomatic: What is called Donglin is the place where Gu Xiancheng read books and lectured.

sentences.zh: 從之遊者如高攀龍、姜士昌、錢一本、劉元珍、安希範、嶽元聲、薛敷教，並束身厲名行，何負國家哉？

translations.literal: Those who followed him in study, such as Gao Panlong, Jiang Shichang, Qian Yiben, Liu Yuanzhen, An Xifan, Yue Yuansheng, and Xue Fujiao, all restrained themselves and cultivated name and conduct — how have they wronged the state?
translations.idiomatic: Those who followed him in study, such as Gao Panlong, Jiang Shichang, Qian Yiben, Liu Yuanzhen, An Xifan, Yue Yuansheng, and Xue Fujiao, all restrained themselves and cultivated name and conduct — how have they wronged the state?

sentences.zh: 偶曰東林，便成陷井。

translations.literal: Merely say Donglin and it becomes a trap.
translations.idiomatic: Merely say Donglin and it becomes a trap.

sentences.zh: 如鄒元標、趙南星等被以此名，即力阻其進。

translations.literal: Men such as Zou Yuanbiao and Zhao Nanxing, once labeled with this name, immediately had their advancement strenuously blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Men such as Zou Yuanbiao and Zhao Nanxing, once labeled with this name, immediately had their advancement strenuously blocked.

sentences.zh: 所朝上而夕下者，惟史繼偕諸人耳。

translations.literal: Those appointed in the morning and dismissed in the evening are only men such as Shi Jijie.
translations.idiomatic: Those appointed in the morning and dismissed in the evening are only men such as Shi Jijie.

sentences.zh: 人才邪正，實國祚攸關，惟陛下察焉。

translations.literal: Whether talent is wicked or upright truly concerns the fate of the dynasty — may Your Majesty examine this.
translations.idiomatic: Whether talent is wicked or upright truly concerns the fate of the dynasty — may Your Majesty examine this.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，眾益恨之。

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted, the multitude hated him all the more.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted, the multitude hated him all the more.

sentences.zh: 亮嗣等既往勘，久之無所得。

translations.literal: Liang and his successors had already gone to investigate; after a long while they obtained nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Liang and his successors had already gone to investigate; after a long while they obtained nothing.

sentences.zh: 第如光復言還報，遂落職為民。

translations.literal: They merely reported back as Guangfu had said, and Sancai was thereupon dismissed from office and made a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: They merely reported back as Guangfu had said, and Sancai was thereupon dismissed from office and made a commoner.

sentences.zh: 天啟元年，遼陽失。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianqi, Liaoyang was lost.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianqi (1621), Liaoyang was lost.

sentences.zh: 御史房可壯連疏請用三才。

translations.literal: Censor Fang Kezhuang submitted linked memorials asking that Sancai be employed.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Fang Kezhuang submitted linked memorials asking that Sancai be employed.

sentences.zh: 有詔廷臣集議。

translations.literal: An edict ordered court ministers to assemble in discussion.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered court ministers to assemble in discussion.

sentences.zh: 通政參議吳殿邦力言不可用，至目之為盜臣。

translations.literal: Participating Secretary of the Office of Transmission Wu Dianbang argued forcefully that he could not be used, going so far as to call him a treacherous minister.
translations.idiomatic: Participating Secretary of the Office of Transmission Wu Dianbang argued forcefully that he could not be used, going so far as to call him a treacherous minister.

sentences.zh: 御史劉廷宣復薦三才，言：「國家既惜其才，則用之耳，又何議，然廣寧已有王化貞，不若用之山海。

translations.literal: Censor Liu Tingxuan again recommended Sancai, saying: "If the state already cherishes his talent, then employ him — what is there to discuss? Yet Guangning already has Wang Huazhen; better to use him on the mountain-sea frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Liu Tingxuan again recommended Sancai, saying, "If the state already cherishes his talent, then employ him — what is there to discuss? Yet Guangning already has Wang Huazhen; better to use him on the mountain-sea frontier.

sentences.zh: 」帝是其言，即欲用三才，而廷議相持未決。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his words and wished at once to employ Sancai, but court discussion remained deadlocked and undecided.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his words and wished at once to employ Sancai, but court discussion remained deadlocked and undecided.

sentences.zh: 詹事公鼐力言宜用，刑部侍郎鄒元標、僉都御史王德完並主之。

translations.literal: Junior Mentor Gong Ding argued forcefully that he ought to be used; Vice Minister of Punishments Zou Yuanbiao and Assistant Censor-in-Chief Wang Dewan both supported this.
translations.idiomatic: Junior Mentor Gong Ding argued forcefully that he ought to be used; Vice Minister of Punishments Zou Yuanbiao and Assistant Censor-in-Chief Wang Dewan both supported this.

sentences.zh: 已，德完迫眾議，忽變前說。

translations.literal: Before long Dewan, pressed by public discussion, suddenly changed his former view.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Dewan, pressed by public discussion, suddenly changed his former view.

sentences.zh: 及署議，元標亦不敢主。

translations.literal: When it came to signing the discussion, Yuanbiao also did not dare take the lead.
translations.idiomatic: When it came to signing the discussion, Yuanbiao also did not dare take the lead.

sentences.zh: 議竟不決，事遂寢。

translations.literal: Discussion in the end was not decided, and the affair was shelved.
translations.idiomatic: Discussion in the end was not decided, and the affair was shelved.

sentences.zh: 三年，起南京戶部尚書，未上卒。

translations.literal: In the third year he was raised as Minister of Revenue at Nanjing and died before taking up the post.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year (1623) he was raised as Minister of Revenue at Nanjing and died before taking up the post.

sentences.zh: 後魏忠賢亂政，其黨御史石三畏追劾之。

translations.literal: Later, when Wei Zhongxian threw government into disorder, his factional censor Shi Sanwei pursued impeachment against him.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when Wei Zhongxian threw government into disorder, his factional censor Shi Sanwei pursued impeachment against him.

sentences.zh: 詔削籍，奪封誥。

translations.literal: An edict struck him from the rolls and revoked his enfeoffment patent.
translations.idiomatic: An edict struck him from the rolls and revoked his enfeoffment patent.

sentences.zh: 崇禎初復官。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Chongzhen reign his office was restored.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Chongzhen reign his office was restored.

sentences.zh: 三才才大而好用機權，善籠絡朝士。

translations.literal: Sancai was greatly talented and fond of using stratagem; he was skilled at winning over court scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Sancai was greatly talented and fond of using stratagem; he was skilled at winning over court scholars.

sentences.zh: 撫淮十三年，結交遍天下。

translations.literal: As grand coordinator of the Huai for thirteen years, he made friends throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: As grand coordinator of the Huai for thirteen years, he made friends throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 性不能持廉，以故為眾所毀。

translations.literal: By nature he could not maintain integrity, and for this reason was widely slandered.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he could not maintain integrity, and for this reason was widely slandered.

sentences.zh: 其後擊三才者，若邵輔忠、徐兆魁輩，鹹以附魏忠賢名麗逆案。

translations.literal: Those who later attacked Sancai, such as Shao Fuzhong and Xu Zhaokui, were all because they attached themselves to Wei Zhongxian listed in the roster of treason.
translations.idiomatic: Those who later attacked Sancai, such as Shao Fuzhong and Xu Zhaokui, were all because they attached themselves to Wei Zhongxian listed in the roster of treason.

sentences.zh: 而推轂三才，若顧憲成、鄒元標、趙南星、劉宗周，皆表表為時名臣。

translations.literal: Yet those who pushed Sancai forward, such as Gu Xiancheng, Zou Yuanbiao, Zhao Nanxing, and Liu Zongzhou, were all illustrious famous ministers of the age.
translations.idiomatic: Yet those who pushed Sancai forward, such as Gu Xiancheng, Zou Yuanbiao, Zhao Nanxing, and Liu Zongzhou, were all illustrious famous ministers of the age.

sentences.zh: 故世以三才為賢。

translations.literal: Therefore the age regarded Sancai as worthy.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the age regarded Sancai as worthy.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：朋黨之成也，始於矜名，而成於惡異。

translations.literal: The evaluative note says: The formation of factions begins in prizing name and ends in hating difference.
translations.idiomatic: The evaluative note says: The formation of factions begins in prizing name and ends in hating difference.

sentences.zh: 名盛則附之者眾。

translations.literal: When a name flourishes, those who attach themselves are many.
translations.idiomatic: When a name flourishes, those who attach themselves are many.

sentences.zh: 附者眾，則不必皆賢而胥引之，樂其與己同也。

translations.literal: When attachers are many, they need not all be worthy yet all draw one another in, rejoicing that they are the same as oneself.
translations.idiomatic: When attachers are many, they need not all be worthy yet all draw one another in, rejoicing that they are the same as oneself.

sentences.zh: 名高則毀之者亦眾。

translations.literal: When a name is high, those who slander are also many.
translations.idiomatic: When a name is high, those who slander are also many.

sentences.zh: 毀者不必不賢而怒而斥之，惡其與己異也。

translations.literal: Slanderers need not all be unworthy yet in anger they cast others out, hating that they differ from oneself.
translations.idiomatic: Slanderers need not all be unworthy yet in anger they cast others out, hating that they differ from oneself.

sentences.zh: 同異之見岐於中，而附者毀者爭勝而不已，則黨日眾，而為禍熾矣。

translations.literal: When views of sameness and difference diverge within the heart and attachers and slanderers contend for victory without cease, factions grow daily more numerous and calamity burns ever hotter.
translations.idiomatic: When views of sameness and difference diverge within the heart and attachers and slanderers contend for victory without cease, factions grow daily more numerous and calamity burns ever hotter.

sentences.zh: 魏允貞、王國、余懋衡皆以卓犖閎偉之概，為眾望所歸。

translations.literal: Wei Yunzhen, Wang Guo, and Yu Maohéng all possessed outstanding and magnificent bearing and were where the hopes of the multitude rested.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Yunzhen, Wang Guo, and Yu Maohéng all possessed outstanding and magnificent bearing and were where the hopes of the multitude rested.

sentences.zh: 李三才英邁豪俊，傾動士大夫，皆負重名。

translations.literal: Li Sancai was brilliant, dashing, and heroic, stirring the scholar-official class; all bore heavy names.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sancai was brilliant, dashing, and heroic, stirring the scholar-official class; all bore heavy names.

sentences.zh: 當世黨論之盛，數人者實為之魁，則好同惡異之心勝也。

translations.literal: When factional debate of the age was at its height, these several men were in fact its leaders — the heart that loves sameness and hates difference had prevailed.
translations.idiomatic: When factional debate of the age was at its height, these several men were in fact its leaders — the heart that loves sameness and hates difference had prevailed.

sentences.zh: 《易》曰：「渙其群，元吉。

translations.literal: The Book of Changes says: "He disperses his group — supreme good fortune.
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Changes says, "He disperses his group — supreme good fortune.

sentences.zh: 」知此者，其惟聖人乎！

translations.literal: He who understands this — is he not the sage!
translations.idiomatic: He who understands this — is he not the sage!
